method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Indian IT stocks slump up to 7% as Accenture cuts revenue outlook, fueling fresh concerns over sector growth
Equities.summary: Shares of major Indian IT companies fall up to 7% after global sector leader Accenture cuts its revenue guidance.
Equities.reason: Sector-level earnings/guidance shock from a global bellwether (Accenture) is negative for IT/software risk appetite and could depress regional equity flows into India/EM tech names; meaningful for sector rotation narrative.

Equities.title: Emerging Equities Touch Record High as Iran Deal Takes Effect
Equities.reason: Broad macro/regime story: reduced Middle East risk and reopening of shipping/energy flows fuels risk-on flows into EM equities and cyclical sectors — large, cross-market positive for equity risk appetite.

Equities.title: Wall St indexes advance with boost from chips, Iran optimism
Equities.reason: U.S. broad-market move led by semiconductors and geopolitical optimism — reinforces an equity leadership narrative (chips/AI hardware) that offsets hawkish Fed fears and supports risk-on positioning.

Equities.title: Applied Materials, ASML, Lam Hit Record Highs, Lead Chip Gear Stocks Rally
Equities.reason: Sector-specific leadership: chip-equipment rally signals continued tech/hardware leadership (AI/memory capex theme) which is a central driver of US equity upside — meaningful but narrower than macro-wide moves.

Equities.title: U.S.-Iran accord hits early snag after Swiss talks fail to proceed as planned
Equities.summary: Analysts reckon a lasting resolution to the Middle East conflict will take some time to materialize.
Equities.reason: Countervailing geopolitical risk: setback to Iran talks trims near-term risk-on momentum and could reintroduce oil/defense/flight-to-safety flows; important as a near-term headwind but lower relevance vs. deal take-effect headlines.

Equities.title: Schwab Warns of Margin Calls as Concerns Over Tax Bets Mount
Equities.reason: Market structure / liquidity risk: warnings about margin calls and concentrated tax-driven positioning increase downside volatility risk for equities and make current rally more fragile — relevant to risk-management and positioning themes.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: FOMC projections signalling higher-for-longer/higher terminal rates are a major direct driver of global yields rising — negative for bond prices. High relevance as an official policy projection.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Official FOMC policy statement signalled no cut and indicated potential further tightening — pushes yields up and is materially negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Markets are set for a much more hawkish Warsh Fed than expected
Rates.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's tough talk on inflation Wednesday reverberated through financial markets.
Rates.reason: Market commentary pointing to a more hawkish Fed reinforces the bond-selloff/higher-yields narrative — meaningful negative for rates markets.

Rates.title: Warsh’s Commitment to Inflation Fight Sparks Market Slide
Rates.reason: Coverage that Fed leadership’s hawkish stance spurred market declines — indicative of bond-market pressure and continued upward yield risks.

Rates.title: Kalshi traders see greater than 50% odds the Fed will hike rates this year
Rates.summary: The Federal Reserve suggested higher rates could be in the cards, and traders on Kalshi see growing odds of a hike in 2026.
Rates.reason: Market-implied probabilities shifting toward hikes raise short- and medium-term yield expectations — negative for bond prices with clear market-transmission.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - June 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE held Bank Rate but minutes/context around the decision can influence gilt expectations; modest negative tilt given broader market pressure on UK yields due to fiscal/issuance concerns.

Rates.title: UK Bonds Fall as Burnham Win Leaves Markets Speculating on Risks
Rates.reason: Headline of gilts selling off tied to political and fiscal risk (and oil price moves) — direct negative for UK bond prices and part of a broader global gilt repricing.

Rates.title: Outline of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Securities
Rates.reason: BOJ published changes to its JGB purchase framework (MPM references) — reduced/reshaped purchases or operational changes are likely to lift JGB yields. High relevance to rates.

Rates.title: Treatment of the Relaxation of the Terms and Conditions for the Securities Lending Facility
Rates.reason: Operational easing/relaxation in securities-lending terms changes market functioning for JGBs; signals BOJ is altering liquidity/support arrangements — modest negative for bond prices if it reduces BOJ backstop.

Rates.title: Bears step up bets against high-yield sector, shaking up bond traders
Rates.summary: The iShares iBoxx High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG) saw elevated put volume on Thursday.
Rates.reason: Rising bearish positioning in high-yield credit suggests stress/weakness in credit markets and potential widening spreads — negative for corporate bond valuations.

Rates.title: India Short-Bond Rally Faces Risks From Cash Drain, Analysts Say
Rates.reason: Local technical/cash-flow risks threaten a short-bond rally in India — a regional rates risk that could push yields higher if liquidity strains intensify.

Rates.title: Bond Market Gives Its Feedback on the Fed
Rates.reason: Market pieces describing immediate bond-market reaction to Fed messaging — reinforces the dominant narrative that Fed hawkishness is driving yield rises and bond market repricing.

FX.title: ‘Hawkish shift’ in US rates upends global currency bets
FX.summary: Expectations of a Fed rate rise trigger reversal in emerging market and commodity currencies
FX.reason: Broad macro narrative: a hawkish Fed expectation is driving USD strength and reversing prior FX risk trades. This is high‑impact, market‑wide FX news (DXY and EM/commodity FX weakness). Large relevance assigned to reflect systemic FX regime shift.

FX.title: Currency Traders Pile Into Dollar Call Options After Hawkish Fed
FX.reason: Flow evidence that market participants are buying USD exposure via options, reinforcing USD‑strength narrative and potential for further FX volatility. High relevance for FX flows/liquidity.

FX.title: Yen nears weakest in 40 years as BOJ hike fails to stem rout
FX.reason: Major currency-specific development: sharp JPY depreciation is central to the USD‑strength story and raises global intervention risk. High relevance given historic lows and systemic implications.

FX.title: Why Japan's $70 billion-plus intervention and a rate hike didn't prop up the yen more
FX.summary: Japan was willing to step in to defend the yen around the 160 level before, and it's at that point again.
FX.reason: Explains limits of policy/FX intervention to stop JPY weakness — supports view that USD momentum may persist despite central‑bank actions. Important for intervention risk and cross‑market dynamics.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index remains near 101.00 amid Fed hawkish outlook
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, remains flat after two days of gains and is trading around 100.83 during the Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY read: sustained USD strength amid hawkish Fed pricing. Medium relevance as it captures the headline USD direction that is driving FX moves.

FX.title: Euro: Dollar strength weighs on pair – Deutsche Bank
FX.summary: Deutsche Bank reports that the Dollar Index rose 0.65% to 100.98, while EUR/USD slipped to 1.144. The move comes as US Treasuries partially retraced prior Fed‑driven losses, with the 10‑year yield down 3.4 bps and jobless claims slightly above expectations.
FX.reason: Institutional note showing EUR/USD pressure from DXY/yield moves — reinforces USD‑led weakness in major pairs. Useful confirmation of market narrative with moderate relevance.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Consolidating above 161.00 amid growing intervention risks
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains offered against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, and the USD/JPY pair stands comfortably around 161.30, its highest level since 2024, way beyond the level that triggered an alleged intervention on April 30.
FX.reason: Price‑forecast/technical piece (limited relevance per framework) but includes intervention commentary — contributes to JPY/intervention narrative with capped relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks rise near 1986 lows – Deutsche Bank
FX.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid highlights that the Japanese Yen is trading near its weakest levels since 1986, with USD/JPY around 161.38 after touching 161.80 in late US trading.
FX.reason: Institutional commentary highlighting extreme JPY weakness and rising intervention probability — material for global FX positioning and risk management.

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as traders ‌ramp up US rate hike bets, Vance canceled trip to talks with Iran
FX.summary: The USD/CHF pair advances to around 0.8075, the highest since December 10, 2025, during the early European session on Friday.
FX.reason: Example of broad G10 FX weakness vs USD as markets price more US tightening; moderate relevance as it confirms cross‑market spillovers.

FX.title: British Pound slides to fresh low since April vs bullish USD amid UK political crisis
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair attracts some follow-through selling for the third straight day and weakens further below the 1.3200 mark, hitting a fresh low since April during the Asian session on Friday.
FX.reason: GBP weakness driven by domestic political risk compounded by USD strength — relevant for G10 FX positioning.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Hits 14-month highs above 1.4150 as bullish bias prevails
FX.summary: USD/CAD holds ground for the seventh consecutive day, trading around 1.4140 during the European hours on Friday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is moving upwards within the ascending channel pattern, signaling a persistent bullish
FX.reason: Technical/price‑forecast piece (capped relevance) but captures commodity‑linked CAD underperformance as USD and oil dynamics weaken CAD — relevant for CAD flows.

FX.title: Bessent Urged by US Senators to Push China on Undervalued Yuan
FX.reason: Political/FX policy pressure on CNY from US lawmakers can influence USD/CNY dynamics and capital flows. Moderate relevance as a regional FX policy signal rather than immediate market mover.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds losses near $64.50 as US-Iran peace optimism fades
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) loses ground for the third successive day, trading around $64.70 per troy ounce during the European hours on Friday. Silver price remains under pressure as persistent concerns over inflation and high interest rates are revived by mountin
Commodities.reason: Precious-metal specific: hawkish Fed/stronger-rate expectations and USD pressure are the dominant drivers pushing silver lower. High relevance because it’s a direct price outlook for silver and reinforces the broader metals downtrend.

Commodities.title: Gold languishes near weekly low amid Fed hike bets, bullish USD, Iran uncertainty
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its heavily offered tone heading into the European session and currently trades just above a one-week low, touched earlier this Friday.
Commodities.reason: Direct gold market piece: hawkish Fed bets and a stronger USD are the primary negative drivers for gold prices. High relevance because it signals a clear metals sell narrative tied to macro-rate trajectory.

Commodities.title: Gold Set for Weekly Loss as Hawkish Fed Outweighs Peace Deal
Commodities.reason: Major-market source reinforcing the same dominant narrative: Fed hawkishness and USD strength outweigh geopolitical easing, increasing downside pressure on gold. High relevance due to Bloomberg’s market-impact reporting.

Commodities.title: OPEC chief dismisses IEA supply glut forecast as 'critical' Strait of Hormuz reopens
Commodities.summary: The IEA said on Wednesday that a lasting resolution to the conflict could drive a surge in supply volumes and trigger a major oil overhang next year.
Commodities.reason: OPEC official pushback against IEA’s oversupply call is bullish for oil prices (keeps risk premium/tighter-supply narrative alive). Relevance medium-high because it affects market positioning vs. competing IEA view.

Commodities.title: Oil: Flow resumption tempers war premium – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank reports that Brent Oil initially fell after the US‑Iran memorandum of understanding, as investors faded war‑related economic fears, before reversing to close slightly higher near $79.85.
Commodities.reason: Institutional bank note: resumption of flows is trimming the war risk premium (mild negative for oil). Relevance limited-medium because this is an interpretative market-comment piece rather than new supply data.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Trades above $75.50 on Iran uncertainty; 200-day SMA holds the key
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on the overnight bounce from the $72.80 region, or the lowest level since early March, and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Near-term oil technical/price outlook noting limited upside despite geopolitical noise — overall mildly negative placement because easing Strait risks and demand focus are capping price support.

Commodities.title: Oil rebounds as postponed U.S.-Iran talks temper optimism over ceasefire progress
Commodities.summary: With immediate supply fears fading and tanker traffic returning to the Strait of Hormuz, traders are turning their attention back to oil demand and OPEC's outlook for the market.
Commodities.reason: Short-term rebound driven by postponed talks and shifting focus to demand/OPEC — modest positive signal but limited relevance versus the broader easing-of-risk premium theme.

Commodities.title: Oil Set for Deep Weekly Loss as Hormuz Traffic Starts to Pick Up
Commodities.reason: Major-source summary that rising Hormuz traffic is driving a material weekly decline — clear negative for oil price risk premium. High relevance because it frames the market’s weekly direction.

Commodities.title: Three Saudi oil tankers carrying 6 million barrels cross Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.summary: The Saudi tankers switched their transponders on Thursday after hiding their location for more than two months.
Commodities.reason: Hard supply-flow evidence: visible tanker movements and resumed exports reduce near-term supply fear premium — moderately negative for oil prices with tangible shipping data.

Commodities.summary: The Permian region's marketed natural gas production grew from 17.2 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2021 to 27.6 Bcf/d in 2025, a 60% increase, according to data from our latest Short Term Energy Outlook. Over the same period, crude oil production grew b
Commodities.reason: Significant supply-side increase for US natural gas (Permian) is bearish for gas prices and relevant to energy-market balances; medium-high relevance due to magnitude and direct supply implication.

Crypto.reason: Reinforces the regulatory push toward bank‑style AML/KYC for stablecoins — legitimizing but also increasing compliance; overall supportive for long‑term institutional adoption.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin traders load up on bearish bets all the way down to $52,000
Crypto.reason: Derivatives positioning shows rising short/bear exposure — increases downside tail‑risk and reduces likelihood of quick rebound.

Crypto.reason: Sustained price below mining cost pressures miner economics and supply incentives — negative for network health and near‑term sell pressure.

Crypto.title: Crypto market positioning is 'defensive and thin' after Fed, Marex analysts say
Crypto.reason: Analyst read of market positioning as defensive supports the broader risk‑off narrative and suggests fragile liquidity in crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Live markets: price action turns panicky in Saylor's STRC as bitcoin drops below $63,000

Crypto.reason: Historical long‑term buy signal commentary is mildly bullish for long‑term allocation narratives but is low signal for near‑term price moves (technical/historical analysis).

Crypto.title: Next bull run will be slower, less volatile as investors' crypto appetite evolves, Bitwise CIO says
Crypto.reason: Structural view that future cycles will be driven by gradual institutional adoption (lower volatility) — modestly positive for asset‑class maturation.

Crypto.title: CME chief executive says company plans to sue CFTC after perpetual futures approval
Crypto.reason: High‑profile legal confrontation over market structure/perpetual futures approval increases regulatory uncertainty and could disrupt derivatives markets — negative for crypto market functioning and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Ex-Celsius CEO Mashinsky gets U.S. CFTC ban in final resolution with regulator
Crypto.reason: Enforcement action underscores ongoing regulatory/legal crackdown risk — negative for sentiment and highlights compliance risks for market participants.

Crypto.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
Crypto.reason: Integration with Visa network for identity/payment rails supports real‑world payments adoption and interoperability — constructive for crypto payments infrastructure.

Crypto.reason: Regulatory exploration to fold DeFi into MiCA signals progress toward a clearer EU rulebook for decentralized finance — modestly positive for legal clarity and institutional engagement.

Crypto.title: The great rotation: Investors desert the Magnificent 7, crypto for AI bottlenecks
Crypto.reason: Flows rotating into AI and away from crypto reduce investor interest/capital into the space — a headwind for near‑term demand and prices.
